recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-14956 unless the work group separately wants all conceptual diagram labels normalized to exact resource-name casing.
issue_request: FHIR-14956 was a Published/Persuasive OO STU3 change request asking that the high-level figure in the Diagnostics Module correct the obsolete ProcedureRequest resource name to ServiceRequest.
initial_application: The direct historical application appears to be git commit bfe0f386b8ca990099c6f5748a19fc98fbde1b73, "GF#15137, GF#14956", which modified images/diagnostic-module-resources.png. The broader resource rename had already reached source/diagnostics-module.html in commit 06bd9f6ffe08096694a3424721006e5fdcd82d3a, which replaced ProcedureRequest page text and links with ServiceRequest.
additional_context: The current build includes diagnostics-module.html and diagnostic-module-resources.png through publish.ini, and ServiceRequest is an active current resource in source/fhir.ini. The current diagnostics module page names ServiceRequest in the index, narrative, and resource table. The current diagram asset and PPTX source no longer contain Procedure Request or ProcedureRequest; the visible label is "Service Request", consistent with the figure's display-style labels such as "Diagnostic Report" rather than a reintroduction of the obsolete ProcedureRequest resource. FHIR-15137 is the same diagram typo family and already has a no-change audit commit on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source and included diagram no longer contain the obsolete ProcedureRequest wording that FHIR-14956 asked to remove, and normalizing the conceptual diagram's display label to exact CamelCase would be optional editorial cleanup beyond the applied Jira request.

related_jiras.note: Separate Published/Persuasive correction for the same diagnostics module diagram typo; already represented by combined-branch audit commit 62f873ff856db6b2437098d6e20ea7070e776ecb.
